release_notes: OLED 2.42 beta build 76. Corrects unintended Wi-Fi loss when opening Advanced settings or saving unrelated configuration. Separates the page-view control from the main settings form, adds a five-second Wi-Fi grace period, uses non-destructive soft reconnect before stored-profile recovery, and prevents brief Wi-Fi status changes from clearing the DHCP address. Defers Nightscout SAGE refresh after settings changes and restarts mDNS only when the local alias changes. Retains persistent three-profile Wi-Fi storage, full NVS factory reset, verified OTA finalization, independent OTA restart guard, fixed setup hotspot, dedicated cloud-alert and buzzer tasks, daily treatment history, Nightscout SAGE, IOB and COB support, and caregiver WhatsApp routing.
